name: passive_soi_mmi2x2
description: Generic-PDK 2x2 MMI from Liu and Poon's Lumerical/Tidy3D comparison.

oracle.reference: Liu and Poon, arXiv:2506.16665v3, Sec. 3.3 and Fig. 12

layer_stack_reference.z_reference: Layer zmin values are measured from the shared silicon substrate plane at z=0 um

simulation.frequency_sampling: Uniform frequency samples between c / wavelength_stop and c / wavelength_start, matching the reference Tidy3D pipeline.
simulation.resolution_m_basis: The top-level resolution_m is the 6 cells-per-wavelength spacing in silicon at 1550 nm, used as the automatic mesh criterion.
simulation.grid: BeamZ GridSpec.auto with the requested minimum cells per wavelength, a 1.4 maximum adjacent-cell scale, and no mesh overrides, matching the reference automatic non-uniform policy.
simulation.subpixel: BeamZ diagonal Farjadpour interface averaging; Tidy3D uses ContourPathAveraging, for which BeamZ has no identical implementation.
simulation.beamz_output_monitor_offset_rationale: The reference output planes coincide with the inner absorbing-boundary interface. BeamZ moves the power-only monitors along the same straight lossless ports to avoid coarse-grid absorbing-region fields.
simulation.source_time: Gaussian pulse with fwidth equal to the simulated frequency span
simulation.source_offset: Tidy3D default: 5 temporal widths; BeamZ equivalent: 5 / (2 pi)
simulation.source_mode_profiles: Three profiles for the 20 nm span. BeamZ uses its native Chebyshev reconstruction nodes.
simulation.beamz_boundary: A 1 um CPML physical absorbing layer on every side.
simulation.beamz_port_span_rationale: An in-domain symmetric 3 um plane centered on each waveguide.
simulation.auto_shutoff: BeamZ field-energy decay threshold 1e-5 with the configured run time as a hard upper bound, matching Tidy3D's published shutoff threshold as closely as available.
simulation.material_model_limitation: BeamZ currently uses nondispersive silicon and silica evaluated at 1550 nm; the paper uses fitted dispersive material models.

published_cross_power_1550nm_span20nm.value_basis: Values at 6 and 15 cells per wavelength are stated in Section 3.3; remaining values are digitized to approximately 0.001 from Fig. 12(a).

published_converged_cross_power_1550nm_s.value_basis: Section 3.3 identifies 15 cells per wavelength as sufficient. The consensus and tolerance use both solvers at 15, 20, and 25 cells per wavelength.
